# Gramlot examples 0.3.7 — Share numeric sizes between sliders and splitters

The nested regions playground (l05) now connects its seven sliders and region dimensions to the same plain numeric pointers. Splitter dragging immediately updates each slider; slider edits resize the region. Python and JavaScript show the same declarations and tutorial.

The browser regression covers all seven regions, keyboard resizing, Data updates before pointer release and retained customer content. Verified in Chromium and WebKit on both galleries, with 112 JS and 19 Python tests passing. Requires core 0.3.4 or later; dependencies remain uncapped.
